import codecs as module
Module = type(module)
assert Module.__dir__(module) == list(module.__dict__)
marker = []
module.__dir__ = lambda: marker
assert Module.__dir__(module) is marker
del module.__dir__
assert Module.__dir__(module) == list(module.__dict__)
print('verified')
